name: Creekside Welding and Fabrication LLC

about:
Creekside Welding and Fabrication LLC operates from Bowman, South Carolina, serving Orangeburg and Dorchester counties. The company has been in business for over five years, offering welding, steel design, and fabrication services to the region.

The shop provides a range of metalworking services including MIG, TIG, and stick welding; mobile welding for on-site repairs; plasma cutting; custom steel fabrication; CAD drawing and design; repair of construction, forestry, and farm equipment; steel demolishing; and steel building sales and erection.

Its customer base spans construction, forestry, and agricultural sectors, along with commercial, industrial, and residential clients. The company's SCDOT welding certification allows it to work on government and large-scale infrastructure projects, and its mobile unit travels to job sites and remote farm locations.

Creekside emphasizes its combination of modern CAD technology with traditional welding craftsmanship, a commitment to safety and quality, and a mission to exceed customer expectations through reliable, locally focused service.
